mapper.update: UPDATE recommendation_effects e INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, target_id, MIN(created_at) AS first_click FROM user_behavior_log WHERE action_type = 2 AND target_type = 1 AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY user_id, target_id ) c ON e.user_id = c.user_id AND e.article_id = c.target_id AND DATE(e.show_time) = DATE(#{clickDate}) SET e.is_click = 1, e.click_time = c.first_click WHERE e.is_click = 0 OR e.is_click IS NULL

UPDATE recommendation_effects e INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, target_id, MIN(created_at) AS first_collect FROM user_behavior_log WHERE action_type = 3 AND target_type = 1 AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY user_id, target_id ) c ON e.user_id = c.user_id AND e.article_id = c.target_id AND DATE(e.show_time) = DATE(#{collectDate}) SET e.is_collect = 1, e.collect_time = c.first_collect WHERE e.is_collect = 0 OR e.is_collect IS NULL
